description: Joules measure how long a surge protector lasts, not how well it protects. Learn UL 1449 VPR, EMS features and what RV campers should buy.
directAnswer: A joule rating shows how much surge energy a protector can absorb over its life, not how well it shields your gear. Check the UL 1449 let-through voltage (330 V is best) and choose an EMS with low-voltage cutoff for an RV air conditioner.
